Here are the five rock‑bands that routinely top worldwide album‑sales charts, and the frontmen who have carried the bulk of their vocal work:

| Rank (by global album sales) | Band | Lead vocalist(s) (most recent & most iconic) |
|------------------------------|------|----------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **The Beatles** | John Lennon (main lead on classics like *Help!* and *Yesterday*; Paul McCartney also sang many hits) |

| 3 | **Led Zeppelin** | Robert Plant (lead on the entire classic catalogue, from *Whole World* to *Stairway to Heaven*) |
| 4 | **Pink Floyd** | David Gilmour (lead from *The Wall* onward – *Comfortably Numb*, *Another Brick*); originally Syd Barrett sang the early hits. |
| 5 | **AC/DC** | Brian Johnson (lead from *Back in Black* to the present; originally Bon Scott sang the early catalog). |
